text:
lina-support: Customer reports high latency; p50 ~600ms vs typical 60ms. They say requests are routing to us-west-2 instead of eu-west1. Sample curl they sent:

lina-support: ```curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -H "X-Client-Region:   " https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate``` 

samir-eng: Can you drop the request-id / proxy log for one of the misrouted requests?

lina-support: Request-id `rk_01F0A3...`; edge logs show: `received_headers:{"x-client-region":"\u0020\u0020"}` and router decision: `route: nearest-pop(us-west-2) fallthrough: region-header-empty`.

devin-sdk: FYI we shipped a patch last month that trims headers, but only for node-fetch; browser fetch flow left a path where user code can set header to whitespace string. SDK v2.3.1 still sends whatever value user sets. Repro easy in browser.

samir-eng: Ok i think router treats any zero-length after trim as absent, but if header is present and contains whitespace it currently isn't normalized. Quick mitigation: treat header value that matches `^[\s]*$` as empty on ingress.

devin-sdk: Repro steps I used:
1) open console
2) `fetch('/v1/generate',{method:'POST',headers:{'X-Client-Region':'   '},body:...})`
3) observe route to nearest pop

devin-sdk: User-agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh) AppleWebKit/537.36. SDK patch PR: will auto-trim header before sending in next minor.

oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Hotfix queued by samir-eng — normalizing whitespace-only region header at edge. Deploy ETA ~25m.

samir-eng: Deploy will add router rule + unit test + small telemetry counter for whitespace-region hits. Lina, please escalate billing credit + let customer know. We'll follow up with postmortem in #postmortems.

lina-support: thanks — pinging customer that we're rolling a fix and starting billing review. Will update thread when patch lands. :thumbsup:
